adjudication.rationale: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb a feed_key method is defined (SHA1 of SiteSetting.feed_polling_url) but is never referenced anywhere in the job. The job always does `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` and iterates all items each run, so there is no implemented caching/"modified" tracking using that key. However, TopicEmbed.import dedupes by embed_url/content_sha1, so this is more an inefficiency/incomplete feature (dead code + unnecessary full reprocessing) than a directly verifiable correctness bug.
